purpose: Turn the structurally promoted RX J2129 system into the first strict R1-ready same-object dynamics-plus-lensing data package without inspecting or fitting any gravity residual.

kinematic_covariance_result.predecessor_failure: The E-MILES baseline was broader than MUSE in the fitted rest-frame range, making its nominal instrumental-resolution variants non-informative.

baryonic_partial_result.passed: The Tian/Cooke published Hernquist BCG baseline is numeric in all four bins and preserves the shared 10-percent total-mass and effective-radius nuisances.
baryonic_partial_result.psf_result: Three predeclared field stars pass the F125W and F814W centroid, FWHM, encircled-energy, pairwise-profile, and leave-one-out gates. A PSF-aware BCG/ICL decomposition may now proceed.
baryonic_partial_result.profile_result: The frozen masked extraction yields 49 usable radial bins in each band, a positive-definite 98x98 cross-band covariance, and a fitted center offset of 0.0464 arcsec. Two Sersic terms improve held-out chi2 by 69.8% in F125W and 77.1% in F814W, but their 94.9% outer-light fraction violates the frozen 5-80% BCG/ICL gate. Total light is measured; the physical component split is explicitly non-identifiable.
baryonic_partial_result.satellite_result: A 43-label candidate-domain classifier passes grouped held-out gates with 57.1% Brier improvement, 30.6% log-loss improvement, AUC 0.918, and calibration error 0.077. Its 2000-draw off-center stellar-force profile has a positive 4x4 covariance; Plummer-scale shifts peak at 1.18% of BCG acceleration and the worst-case outer tidal bound peaks at 0.871%, below its frozen 1% limit.
baryonic_partial_result.failed: The frozen BCG/ICL identifiability gate failed and therefore does not authorize Cooke-aperture component mass mapping. The four-bin hot-gas profile remains incomplete; lens member dark-subhalo scaling is also separate from the completed satellite stellar-force term.
baryonic_partial_result.public_gas_obstruction: Tian transcribes one 14.3-kpc Chandra cumulative-mass point. The Donahue source archive contains a plotted profile and model equations but no machine-readable radial samples or covariance; no radial gas law was invented from the single anchor.

required_outputs: four-bin velocity-dispersion profile with statistical and protocol-systematic errors
4x4 covariance matrix with all off-diagonal terms

required_runs.template_families: E-MILES plus XSL when available; otherwise record a hard template-availability shortfall rather than treating the component as zero

kinematic_covariance.result: All 100 XSL block-bootstrap replicates and all nine non-baseline protocols completed. The 4x4 covariance is positive definite; every total fractional uncertainty is below 0.024 and the maximum protocol shift is 0.0391.
kinematic_covariance.failure_response: Stop the RX J2129 dynamics branch if any bin fails after the frozen sensitivity grid. Do not tune annuli, masks, templates, or thresholds after seeing the result.

required_components: BCG stellar light or surface-mass profile over 0-5 arcsec with PSF and stellar-M/L uncertainty
intracluster-light contribution over 0-5 arcsec with normalization uncertainty
hot-gas projected mass profile with uncertainty
satellite and other explicitly modeled cluster-galaxy contributions with nuisance priors
baryonic_forward_inputs.negligible_component_rule: A component may be omitted only if an observable-based upper bound shows that its projected acceleration is below 1 percent of the total baryonic acceleration in every analysis bin.
baryonic_forward_inputs.result: A four-bin published Hernquist BCG baseline and covariance, the empirical F125W/F814W PSF, a 49-bin-per-band total-light profile, and a normalized off-center satellite stellar-force likelihood are complete. The two-Sersic total-light shape fails the physical component-fraction gate, so BCG/ICL is non-identifiable and no component mass mapping is authorized. Radial gas remains missing.
baryonic_forward_inputs.failure_response: Record the exact missing profile or uncertainty as a public-data obstruction and keep strict R1-ready false.

required_outputs: rerunnable lens configuration or independently implemented image-position likelihood
explicit source-position and mass-component nuisance parameters and priors
posterior samples or an equivalent numerical covariance product
posterior-predictive image positions and per-image residuals
observable_lens_likelihood.known_obstruction: Jauzac et al. 2021 provide the image catalog and likelihood error but no public model chain/configuration. The independent observable-level replacement fit passes its all-image engineering gate but cannot establish predictive closure because its frozen protocol omitted a numerical heldout-adequacy threshold.
observable_lens_likelihood.current_result: The independent smooth-halo model reproduces all 21 images with exact radial RMS 0.3833 arcsec, reduced coordinate chi2 0.6856, and a finite 24x24 Laplace covariance. Its seven-image blind holdout is much worse at 1.4299 arcsec, and adding the 66-member layer worsens heldout RMS to 2.7265 arcsec. The holdout validly rejects the added member layer, but the missing predeclared adequacy threshold forbids a predictive or Weyl-response claim. No published model residual, best-fit mass parameter, or GR mass map was used.
observable_lens_likelihood.failure_response: Retain the all-image fit as an engineering control. Correct predictive adequacy only on a fresh blind system or genuinely unspent split; do not tune RX J2129 on its spent holdout or substitute a published GR-derived convergence map.

assembled_same_object_package.success_outcome: Set RX J2129 strict_r1_ready=true and authorize only the nuisance-marginalized dynamical/Weyl Jacobian audit.
assembled_same_object_package.failure_response: Keep the structural promotion as an engineering result, publish the failed gate, and continue the replacement inventory without fitting a gravity law.

rethink_clock.on_rethink: Do not loosen a numerical gate. Decide whether to seek non-public products, promote another structurally qualified system, or issue a hard public-data shortfall for strict R1 readiness.
